events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was completed and verified. The confirmation (evidence #17) shows Willow as Confirmed for 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, reservation total $245 all charges included CAD, within the $350 limit. The saved reservations list (evidence #19) shows the same Quarterly planning entry as Confirmed, Willow, 12 people, Projector, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, $245.

Interpretação simulada: The visible booking path allowed the persona to meet capacity, projector, purpose, one-hour slot, and budget requirements and then verify the saved reservation without payment details.

Limites: The reservation is stated on screen to be a demo saved only in this browser session, so persistence beyond this session was not established.

Capturas indicadas: #17, #19, #15, #7. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Suitable room booked and verified within budget
findings.observation: Willow was listed for 12 seats with a Projector at $245 total (evidence #7), the review repeated 12 people, projector included and $245 total (evidence #15), the confirmation showed Confirmed status with the same details (evidence #17), and My reservations listed the saved Confirmed booking (evidence #19).
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose, and an all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Charter success criteria and persona explicit requirements stated in the mission.
findings.personaComment: This covered everyone, included the projector, and came in well under budget.
findings.interpretation: The end-to-end flow satisfied all stated requirements in this observed run.
findings.uncertainty: Only this browser-session demo reservation was observed; longer-term persistence was not tested.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Landing page shows two rooms, Atlas $280 and Willow $245, both listed as 12 seats with Projector and available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Willow fits all 12 of us with a projector and is well within budget, so I'll go with that one.

experience.observation: Form shows Tomorrow, 10:00-11:00, 12 people, and 'We need a projector' checked, with a 'See available rooms' button.
experience.reaction: The time, headcount and projector already line up, so I'll continue to the rooms.

experience.observation: Room list shows Atlas $280 and Willow $245, both 12 seats with Projector; meeting summary confirms 12 people and projector required.
experience.reaction: Willow meets the seat and projector needs for $245, so I'm sticking with it.

experience.observation: Your meeting page shows an empty Meeting name field, with Willow summary on the right: Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector included, $245 total.
experience.reaction: The Willow details check out, so I'll add the meeting name next.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and empty, ready for input, with the Willow $245 summary unchanged.
experience.reaction: I'll name this Quarterly planning as requested.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads 'Quarterly planning'; Willow summary remains $245 total for 12 people with projector included.
experience.reaction: Name is in, so I'll check the review before confirming.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12, Willow Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, total $245 all charges included, with a Confirm reservation button.
experience.reaction: Everything on the review matches my requirements and budget, so I'll confirm.

experience.observation: Confirmation page says 'You've got a room', Quarterly planning booked at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00-11:00, 12 people, projector included, $245 total.
experience.reaction: The confirmation looks right, so I'll just check it's saved in my reservations.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
